'''Rogue 3'''<ref name="CCG-Rogue3" /> was an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]<ref name="CCG-Snowspeeder" /> modified [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. Assigned to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]],<ref name="CCG-Rogue3" /> the vehicle was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" /> Rogue 3 was assigned to be [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]<ref name="CCG-Rogue3" /> with [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] serving as the craft's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Rogue 3 was the first Alliance snowspeeder to successfully trip an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] using a [[flexisteel]] tow cable. Rogue 3 survived the battle, but the craft was abandoned on Hoth during the evacuation of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="CCG-Rogue3" />
